name: Whispering Woods
description: Forest whose overwhelming magic clouded Greensleeves's thoughts.

description_citations.text: "Whispering Woods (novel)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gull and Greensleeves see the Brain fall as a star; Towser retrieves it, thinking it a mana vault.
timeline.quote: the wizard Towser retrieved it with their help, believing it to be a mana vault

citation.text: "Stone Brain", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Brain's workings are revealed; Haakon is tested and becomes Greensleeves' slave.
timeline.quote: he became a sort of slave to Greensleeves

citation.text: "Stone Brain", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haakon summons Phyrexian Gremlins who steal the Brain; Greensleeves planeswalks to it and finds she can resist its voices.
timeline.quote: she found out that she could resist the voices

citation.text: "Stone Brain", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The army captures Dacian and puts the helmet on him; Dacian and Haakon form a truce and seek Karli and Towser.
timeline.quote: Dacian and Haakon formed a truce

citation.text: "Stone Brain", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rakel is teleported to Greensleeves' camp as Karli attacks, and agrees to join their crusade.
timeline.quote: The warrior woman quickly agrees to join their "crusade".

citation.text: "Shattered Chains", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves is compelled to leave camp and finds Chaney, who trains her; years pass in Chaney's house.
timeline.quote: time in Chaney's house flows differently

citation.text: "Shattered Chains", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves and Chaney discover the Mana Vault is the Stone Brain, made by the Sages of Lat-Nam.
timeline.quote: the fallen star Mana Vault is, in reality, the " Stone Brain "

citation.text: "Shattered Chains", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rakel tries to commit suicide when Sabriam's deadline passes; Gull saves her and learns the truth.
timeline.quote: she tries to commit suicide.

citation.text: "Shattered Chains", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Benalish troops kidnap Rakel again; Haakon summons Phyrexian Gremlins who steal the Stone Brain.
timeline.quote: who snatch the artifact and return to their home plane

citation.text: "Shattered Chains", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lily and Greensleeves shift away with Chaney's artifacts.
timeline.quote: Both are now able to successfully teleport away.

citation.text: "Shattered Chains", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dacian is captured and made to wear the Stone Brain; Garth arrives furious and is calmed by Rakel.
timeline.quote: The army captures Dacian and puts the helmet on the wizard.

citation.text: "Shattered Chains", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chaney dies of old age, donating her life force to Greensleeves.
timeline.quote: while Chaney dies of old age, donating her life force to Greensleeves.

citation.text: "Shattered Chains", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The convoy reaches the fallen star, a Mana Vault; another wizard attacks, trying to kidnap Lily and Greensleeves, and is defeated by a Fungusaur.
timeline.quote: The star is revealed by Towser to be a Mana Vault

citation.text: "Whispering Woods (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gull and Greensleeves enter a bog and save Kem from Sedge Trolls.
timeline.quote: so Gull and Greensleeves enter the bog and save him.

citation.text: "Whispering Woods (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gull discovers Greensleeves can now talk; Towser reveals he intends to kill her and store her power in the Mana Vault and teleports Gull, Morven and Stiggur away amid a riot.
timeline.quote: the wizard reveals his intention to kill Greensleeves and store her power in the Mana Vault.

citation.text: "Whispering Woods (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gull organizes a ragtag army on the island until he is summoned away.
timeline.quote: Gull refuses to surrender and starts organizing the people on the island in a ragtag army

citation.text: "Whispering Woods (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lily, secretly a wizard, summons Gull; Kem changes sides, and Greensleeves, revealed as a wizard, summons allies and then an earthquake that plunges them into the sea.
timeline.quote: She resolves to use an earthquake , which destroys the cliff they are on and plunges them into the sea.

citation.text: "Whispering Woods (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Towser escapes a tsunami by flight; Morven and Kem are swept away; Gull realizes Towser killed his family and vows to form an army against evil wizards.
timeline.quote: Gull and his friends vow to form an army to fight Towser

citation.text: "Whispering Woods (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Three years on, Greensleeves is weary and visited by Chaney's shade, who warns of a final sacrifice.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves is also frequently visited by the shade of Chaney , who advises the druid, in cryptic words, that she'll need to make the "final sacrifice".

citation.text: "Final Sacrifice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Towser and Karli summon nine defeated wizards to the tropical island; Towser has stolen and copied the Nova Pentacle and reveals his Keldon warlord.
timeline.quote: Towser reveals that he has stolen Greensleeves' Nova Pentacle and copied it.

citation.text: "Final Sacrifice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The wizards attack the Woods from three directions; Petalia is lost in the Abyss when Greensleeves banishes Ur-Drago.
timeline.quote: Immediately, the wizards attack the Woods from three different directions.

citation.text: "Final Sacrifice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves teleports Gull and the survivors to safety before the Keldon warlord can kill Gull.
timeline.quote: before the enemy can kill the woodcutter, Greensleeves teleports herself, Gull, and the survivors of their army to their headquarters.

citation.text: "Final Sacrifice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves kills Gurias in fury and her spells make the enemy flee.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves unleashes her fury, killing him and summoning her most powerful spells, which cause the enemy to flee.

citation.text: "Final Sacrifice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves dons the Stone Brain and learns its ultimate secret lies in the College of Lat-Nam; Chaney's shade passes into the afterlife.
timeline.quote: The same night, Chaney's shade passes in the afterlife, after reminding Greensleeves once more of the final sacrifice.

citation.text: "Final Sacrifice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A shooting star falls in the woods near White Ridge, reputed to be a bad omen.
timeline.quote: a shooting star fell in the woods northwest of their village, which was reputed to be a bad omen

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Dim-witted". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves unknowingly summons a Fungusaur that defeats a wizard who kidnapped her and Lily.
timeline.quote: The wizard was defeated by a Fungusaur summoned by Greensleeves, though neither knew it at the time.

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Speaking". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gull and Greensleeves rescue Kem from Sedge Trolls in a bog, and Greensleeves is found to be able to speak.
timeline.quote: Gull was amazed to find out that Greensleeves could suddenly talk

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Speaking". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Towser reveals his plan to kill Greensleeves and store her power in the mana vault; a fight starts and Towser teleports Gull and friends to an island.
timeline.quote: the wizard revealed his intention to kill Greensleeves and store her power in the mana vault

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Wizard". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lily summons Gull back; Kem changes sides and Greensleeves, revealed as a wizard, summons the creatures of the woods against Towser's minions.
timeline.quote: Kem changed sides and came to her rescue

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Wizard". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves uses an earthquake and a tsunami to defeat Towser, who escapes by flying; Gull's group survives and they vow to form an army against evil wizards.
timeline.quote: They vowed to form an army to fight Towser and all other evil wizards who saw people as mindless pawns.

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Wizard". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Led by a strange voice, Greensleeves finds the druid Chaney, who trains her; five years pass in a few days and she returns grown and more skilled.
timeline.quote: Despite training for around five years, only a few days passed.

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Archdruid". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves and Chaney learn the Mana Vault is the Stone Brain, and Greensleeves uses it on Haakon.
timeline.quote: the Mana Vault was in reality the Stone Brain

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haakon summons Phyrexian gremlins who snatch the Stone Brain and return to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: they snatched the artifact and returned to their home plane

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garth visits the army and gifts Greensleeves his spell satchel.
timeline.quote: gifting Greensleeves his spell satchel

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chaney, dying of old age, gives Greensleeves her remaining life force, making her an archdruid.
timeline.quote: Chaney gave her remaining life force to Greensleeves, making her an archdruid.

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ten wizards led by Towser and Karli, with Ur-Drago and a Keldon warlord, attack the army from three directions; Greensleeves banishes Ur-Drago, losing Petalia to the Abyss.
timeline.quote: Petalia , captain of her bodyguard, was lost in the Abyss when the druid banished Ur-Drago.

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Final sacrifice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves teleports the survivors to her Grove, then kills Gurias in fury and drives off the enemy.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves unleashed her fury, killing him and summoning her most powerful spells, which caused the enemy to flee.

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Final sacrifice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hundreds of years later, sensing the Phyrexians' return, Greensleeves is reborn as the Maro-Sorcerer of the Whispering Woods.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves was reborn as the Maro-Sorcerer of the Whispering Woods, a being of pure elemental power

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Maro-Sorcerer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rakel takes command, the army defeats Haakon and Greensleeves planeswalks to Phyrexia; Garth helps defeat Dacian.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves was successful in planeswalking to Phyrexia, bringing some of her friends with her.

citation.text: "Gull's Crusade", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The army forms Greensleeves's Grove in the Whispering Woods and organizes new units.
timeline.quote: the army formed a community in the Whispering Woods known as Greensleeves's Grove

citation.text: "Gull's Crusade", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Congress attacks from three directions with a Keldon warlord; Greensleeves teleports the survivors to Greensleeves' Grove.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves teleported herself, Gull, and the survivors of their army to their headquarters at Greensleeves' Grove.

citation.text: "Gull's Crusade", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hundreds of years later Greensleeves is reborn as the Maro-Sorcerer of the Whispering Woods.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves was reborn as the Maro-Sorcerer of the Whispering Woods

citation.text: "Gull's Crusade", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garth reappears, recants his planeswalker spark and returns to the vineyard with his family.
timeline.quote: The wizard recanted his planeswalker spark

citation.text: "Norreen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 4073 AR Towser follows a falling object to the Whispering Woods, meets Dacian outside White Ridge, and their battle destroys the village.
timeline.quote: engaged in a battle that resulted in the village's destruction

citation.text: "Towser", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A year later Gull and Greensleeves move their army into the woods and build Greensleeves's Grove.
timeline.quote: Gull and Greensleeves moved their army into the woods.

citation.text: "Whispering Woods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In preparation for the New Phyrexian invasion, the forest manifests a new maro-sorcerer, Greensleeves.
timeline.quote: the forest manifested a new maro-sorcerer: Greensleeves.

citation.text: "Whispering Woods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
